verse.text: So he returned home to his father. And while he was still a long way off, his father saw him coming. Filled with love and compassion, he ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.

reflection: Every dad has a moment when a kid comes home messy — late, wrong, or just needing to be held — and this verse is a picture of how we're called to respond: not with a lecture first, but with a run and an embrace. Leading your family well isn't about never having prodigals; it's about being the kind of father who's already watching the road, ready to close the distance the second they turn around. Let your kids know today that your arms are open before they ever have to explain themselves.
